Put down roots where the cowboy was born

Monthly RV lots, park-owned RVs and tiny homes, made for people who live here. Not a weekend stopover. Quiet, secure, and five minutes from H-E-B.

See open lots Send an inquiry

    Built for residents

    Home base, not a campground

    Vaquero is a long-term community. Our neighbors are oilfield and pipeline crews working the Eagle Ford, retirees, and families who want a simple, affordable place to live close to San Antonio without paying San Antonio prices.

    Monthly leases
    Month-to-month leases. Tell us what you need, sign your lease, and pay through our resident system.
    Ways to live
    Bring your RV (30 or 50 amp), or rent one of our park-owned RVs or tiny homes.
    Safe & connected
    Free park-wide Wi-Fi and 24-hour camera surveillance. Security gates are coming soon.
    Pets welcome
    Bring the dog. A fenced dog park is part of the next build-out.

    Monthly lot rent from

      Things to do

      Life around Pleasanton

      Pleasanton calls itself the birthplace of the cowboy. The old cattle-drive heritage still shows up in its museum, festivals and river parks.

      Phase 2 expansion

      41 more lots on 3 acres next door

      We're growing onto the land beside the park. The plan adds new paved roads and new lots, plus spaces the whole community can use.
